items.name: Radeon Feature Status Reader
items.description: Reads installed AMD Radeon Software state and reports available feature families (HYPR-RX/Anti-Lag/Chill/Boost/RSR/AFMF where detectable).

steps.command: $p='HKLM:\SOFTWARE\AMD\CN'; if(Test-Path $p){ Get-ItemProperty $p | Out-String | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'AMD Adrenalin registry base not detected.' }; exit 0

items.name: AMD MPO Troubleshooting Toggle
items.description: Troubleshooting-only MPO toggle for flicker/stutter diagnostics. Reversible and not guaranteed to improve FPS.

items.name: AMD ULPS Handling (Supported Path Only)
items.description: Checks exact ULPS registry paths before suggesting action; marks unsupported when exact path is absent.

steps.command: $k=Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class' -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'EnableUlps' } | Select-Object -First 1; if($k){ Write-Output "ULPS path detected: $($k.Name)" } else { Write-Output 'ULPS path unsupported on this system.' }; exit 0

items.name: AMD FreeSync / VRR Diagnostics
items.description: Diagnostic readout for VRR readiness and refresh mismatch conditions that often present as stutter.

steps.command: Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-String | Write-Output; Write-Output 'Check monitor OSD FreeSync state + Windows refresh rate alignment.'; exit 0

items.name: AMD Shader Cache Cleanup (Troubleshooting)
items.description: Maintenance-only cleanup of AMD shader caches. First few launches may stutter more while caches rebuild.

items.name: AMD Driver Branch Helper (Stable vs Latest)
items.description: Reads installed AMD display driver version/date and provides stable-vs-latest decision guidance without forced updates.

steps.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_PnPSignedDriver | Where-Object { $_.DeviceClass -eq 'DISPLAY' -and $_.Manufacturer -match 'AMD|Advanced Micro Devices' } | Select-Object DeviceName, DriverVersion, DriverDate | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Output; exit 0

items.name: Imported AMD GPU Mega-Pack (Expert Lab)
items.description: [Imported AMD Expert Lab] High-risk legacy AMD registry pack; desktop-only, hidden from Apply All, and requires backup + typed confirmation before apply.
items.typedConfirmText: I ACCEPT THERMAL AND INSTABILITY RISK
